Unnamed father |trainer=no |game=no |anime=yes |epnum=SM041 |epname=Mounting an Electrifying Charge! |enva=[[Sam Black]] |java=[[Nozomu Sasaki]] }} '''Horacio''' (Japanese: '''ハヤテ''' ''Hayate'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|SM}}. He is a [[rival]] of {{an|Sophocles}}. ==History== In ''[[SM041|Mounting an Electrifying Charge!]]'', Horacio entered the [[Charjabug race]] as the leader of the Red Comet team with his {{Shiny}} {{p|Charjabug}} and his brothers {{OBP|Dana|SM041}} and [[Yansu]]. He was certain that his Charjabug's top-class equipment and {{stat|Speed}}-increasing [[nature]] would allow him to win the race with ease. During the race, he constantly mocked {{an|Sophocles}} and his own {{TP|Sophocles|Charjabug}}. He also kept yelling at his brothers and insisted they keep pushing on, despite the fact that his Charjabug was getting exhausted from all the obstacles it had to face during the race. Eventually, Horacio's Charjabug got stuck when it was unable to climb an ice-covered slope. Sophocles's team eventually won the race, much to Horacio and his brothers' dismay. [[File:Sophocles Horacio Rivalry.png|thumb|250px|left|Horacio's rivalry with Sophocles]] In ''[[SM106|Evolving Research!]]'', Horacio and his brothers arrived at [[Vast Poni Canyon]]. There, he challenged Sophocles to a race to see who could obtain a legendary "Bug Stone" that he believed could evolve any {{type|Bug}}. Due to Sophocles's fear of the dark, he struggled to get through a cave, allowing Horacio to easily get ahead and make his way to a rope bridge that led to the Bug Stone. Horacio tried crossing the bridge, only for it to collapse underneath his feet, leaving him and Charjabug to hold onto it for safety. Sophocles's own Charjabug subsequently evolved into a {{p|Vikavolt}} and carried Horacio and his Charjabug to safety, before retrieving the Bug Stone. Afterwards, Sophocles gave the Bug Stone to Horacio, only for it to not work when he tried it on his Charjabug. He then learned that Charjabug evolve into Vikavolt with the canyon's [[special magnetic field]], not an [[Evolution stone]]. Horacio then vowed to train and evolve his Charjabug so they could face Sophocles in a Vikavolt race one day, before taking his leave. In ''[[SM119|A High-Speed Awakening!]]'', Horacio participated the [[Vikavolt race]] to settle his score with Sophocles. It was also revealed that his {{p|Charjabug}} had evolved into {{p|Vikavolt}} during his time at Vast Poni Canyon. Eventually, he lost the race and congratulated Sophocles for beating him once again before vowing to have a rematch with him someday. ==Character== Horacio was arrogant and condescending, often boasting of his father's money and obtaining exclusive things. He is often flanked by his two brothers. In ''[[SM041|Mounting an Electrifying Charge!]]'', he believed his Charjabug's top-class equipment and {{stat|Speed}}-increasing [[nature]] would allow him to win the [[Charjabug race]] with ease. He was also a bad sport, mocking {{an|Sophocles}} and his {{TP|Sophocles|Charjabug}}. He completely disregarded the well-being of his Pokémon, by not allowing his Charjabug to take a break during pit stops, resulting in Charjabug being too exhausted to continue and allowing Sophocles's own Charjabug to race ahead. This was seen again in ''[[SM106|Evolving Research!]]'', when he arrived at a bridge with the Bug Stone at the other side. He disregarded Sophocles's warning about the bridge being unstable and continued on, resulting in the bridge collapsing, and he had to be saved by Sophocles's newly evolved {{TP|Sophocles|Vikavolt}}. By ''[[SM119|A High-Speed Awakening!]]'', Horacio appeared to have been humbled. After he lost to Sophocles in the [[Vikavolt race]], he offered his rival a friendly handshake. He also learned the value of fair play, as seen during the race, where he had his Vikavolt go back to help Sophocles's Vikavolt after the latter saved it from {{TRT}}'s clutches. Later, after everyone's Vikavolt were freed, he resumed the race at the same time as everyone else. ==Pokémon== This listing is of Horacio's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{MissingInfo|1|java}} {{TrainerPoké |main=Horacio's Vikavolt |trainer=Horacio |pkmn=Vikavolt |shiny=yes |stage1=Charjabug |type1=Bug |type2=Electric |img=Horacio Vikavolt.png |cap=Horacio's Vikavolt |epnum=SM041 |epname=Mounting an Electrifying Charge! |vajp= |vaen=Abe Goldfarb |desc=This {{DL|List of alternately colored Pokémon in animation|Charjabug|Shiny}} {{p|Vikavolt}} is Horacio's only known Pokémon, given to him by his father. In ''[[SM041|Mounting an Electrifying Charge!]]'', Charjabug was entered in the [[Charjabug race|Charjabug race Koko Cup]]. Charjabug ended up losing to {{an|Sophocles}} and his {{TP|Sophocles|Charjabug}}. In ''[[SM119|A High-Speed Awakening!]]'', Charjabug was revealed to have evolved into Vikavolt when Horacio entered the [[Vikavolt race]].}} ==Pokémon competitions== Horacio has competed in the following {{cat|Pokémon competitions}}: * [[Charjabug race|Charjabug race Koko Cup]] - Runner-Up (with [[Yansu]] and {{OBP|Dana|SM041}}; ''[[SM041|Mounting an Electrifying Charge!]]'') * [[Vikavolt race|Vikavolt race Fini Cup]] - Runner-Up (''[[SM119|A High-Speed Awakening!]]'') ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{ruby color light}}|bordercolor={{white color}} |ja=佐々木望 ''[[Nozomu Sasaki]]'' |en=[[Sam Black]] |fi=Ilkka Villi |it=Massimo di Benedetto |pl=Mateusz Rusin ([[SM041]])
